question: Identify the INCORRECT pair of cell shape types and their examples.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oblong – Nerve cells**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4: Oblong – Nerve cells** is the incorrect pair.
 
• Nerve cells typically have a long, thread-like shape, which is more accurately described as elongated or branched rather than oblong.
 
• Other cell shapes mentioned in the options are correctly paired with their examples:
 
 
• **Oval** – Chlamydomonas
 
• **Elongated** – Muscle cells
 
• **Irregular** – Amoeba
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nerve cells**, also known as neurons, have specialized structures such as dendrites and axons that help in transmitting nerve impulses.
 
• The shape of a cell is often related to its function. For example, the elongated shape of muscle cells helps in contraction and relaxation, while the irregular shape of amoebas aids in movement and engulfing food.
 
• **Chlamydomonas** is a single-celled green alga with an oval shape that facilitates its movement in water using flagella.
